h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Pallavaram

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Pallavaram

items.pText: Pallavaram, on Chennai's south-western edge near the airport, has filled up with apartment complexes and gated layouts. In many of them, the play area is small and the evening crowd is large. When twenty children arrive at once, a single slide creates a queue. Equipment that several children can use together works better on these sites.

FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,050 km from Pallavaram, and brings it to Chennai by road. Our installation team or a dealer in Tamil Nadu installs it. In the state we have also installed a resort playground in Dindigul. Send us your space, the number of children likely to use it and some photos. We will suggest group play pieces and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.

items.q: What equipment reduces queues in a busy society play area?
items.a: Pieces that several children can use together, such as merry-go-rounds, multi see-saws, double swings and play systems with more than one slide.

items.q: Do you supply Pallavaram and the southern suburbs of Chennai?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai and install through our own team or a dealer, across Chennai and its suburbs.

items.q: Can a small apartment play area hold group equipment?
items.a: Often, yes. A compact multi play system or a four-seater merry-go-round fits many small sites. Send us the measurements and we will check what fits.
